purpose: A clockwise ring around Iceland built for geothermal, geological and scenic-drive interests, hitting every must-do while keeping to six manageable bases and moderate daily driving.

bases.name: Reykjavik
bases.why: Widest lodging and a natural gateway for Reykjanes geothermal sites and the capital's own historic core.

bases.name: Vik
bases.why: Central to the south coast waterfalls and the gateway to the glacier park.

bases.name: Höfn
bases.why: Closest practical base for the Lónsöræfi hike and the eastern glacier fringe.

bases.name: Egilsstaðir
bases.why: Eastern hub for Seyðisfjörður, Lagarfljót and the road north to Dettifoss.

bases.name: Akureyri
bases.why: Northern capital within reach of Mývatn's volcanic landscapes and northern waterfalls.

bases.name: Reykjavik
bases.why: Returns to the widest departure options after a West Iceland waterfall transfer.

days.theme: Capital orientation and coastal green space

anchors.name: Lækjartorg
anchors.why: Central historic square requested by traveller, easy first-day orientation.

anchors.name: Ylströndin í Nauthólsvík
anchors.why: Relaxed coastal spot to ease into the trip.

anchors.name: Vífilsstaðavatn
anchors.why: Nearby wildlife area, low-effort add-on.

anchors.name: Gunnuhver
anchors.why: Requested hot spring and a strong fit for geothermal interest.

anchors.name: Raufarhólshellir
anchors.why: Requested lava cave, geology-focused anchor.

anchors.name: Kaldárhraun og Gjárnar
anchors.why: Lava field viewpoint that rounds out the geological theme.

anchors.name: Seljalandsfoss
anchors.why: Explicitly requested waterfall on the classic south coast route.

anchors.name: Skógafoss
anchors.why: Major south coast waterfall en route to Vik.

anchors.name: Urriðafoss
anchors.why: Convenient scenic stop along the same drive.

days.theme: Glacier park hike and bird island

anchors.name: Vatnajökulsþjóðgarður
anchors.why: Major day-hike experience in Iceland's largest national park.

anchors.name: Ingólfshöfði
anchors.why: Distinctive wildlife promontory nearby, worth the detour.

anchors.name: Phare de Landahóll
anchors.why: Modest waypoint monument on the drive east toward Höfn.

anchors.name: Hjallanes
anchors.why: Easy hike near Höfn to stretch legs after driving.

anchors.name: Lónsöræfi
anchors.why: Explicitly requested and the trip's most demanding wilderness day hike.

anchors.name: Hjallanes
anchors.why: Complementary shorter walk in the same area if energy allows.

anchors.name: Seyðisfjörður
anchors.why: Iconic fjord town and scenic mountain-pass drive.

anchors.name: Litlanesfoss
anchors.why: Distinctive basalt-column waterfall walk fitting the geology interest.

anchors.name: Hallormsstaður
anchors.why: Easy forest walk to balance the day's driving.

anchors.name: Dettifoss
anchors.why: Major waterfall on the route north, strong scenic-viewpoint fit.

anchors.name: Selfoss
anchors.why: Nearby waterfall easily paired with Dettifoss.

anchors.name: Norðfjarðarkirkja
anchors.why: Small historic stop if time allows on the way out of the fjords.

anchors.name: Dimmuborgir
anchors.why: Explicitly requested lava-formation viewpoint, core geology anchor.

anchors.name: Hverfjall
anchors.why: Adjacent volcanic crater, natural pairing with Dimmuborgir.

anchors.name: Reykjafoss
anchors.why: Explicitly requested easy waterfall walk.

anchors.name: Blönduvatn
anchors.why: Nearby lake worth a look on the return leg.

anchors.name: Herring Era Museum
anchors.why: A change of pace with a distinct cultural stop.

anchors.name: Hraunfossar
anchors.why: Explicitly requested and one of the highest-significance viewpoints in the packet.

anchors.name: Geitland
anchors.why: Explicitly requested viewpoint along the same Borgarfjörður route.

anchors.name: Stóri Geysir
anchors.why: Requested geothermal stop, reachable on the way back toward Reykjavik.

anchors.name: Gálgahraun
anchors.why: Lava-field viewpoint close to Reykjavik for an easy closing day.

anchors.name: Fossvogsbakkar
anchors.why: Convenient coastal viewpoint near the capital.

anchors.name: Lækjartorg
anchors.why: Central, easy final stop before heading to departure.
